description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Prompt Perl module, providing authentication callback functions for git-svn, including handling SSL trust, username, password prompts, and certificate management.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Prompt
classes.description: Perl module providing authentication callback functions for git-svn, handling SSL trust, username, password, and certificate prompts.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles simple authentication by setting username and password, possibly using cached or default username.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Handles SSL server trust validation, displaying certificate info and prompting user to accept or reject.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the client SSL certificate filename.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the password for the client SSL certificate.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts for and sets the username for authentication.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads a password securely from prompt input.
